title: Much smoother
items: New messages no longer make the whole chat redraw: only the new one is added, so busy chats stay smooth (especially on phones) and pictures and videos above stay put.

The loading screen used to keep animating invisibly in the background after Zuno opened, making phones work non-stop. It's now removed once Zuno is ready, so Zuno sits almost completely still when you're not doing anything.
Switching chats is lighter, and nothing animates while Zuno is in the background.
Lots of small behind-the-scenes speed-ups for phones.
